headline: Light rises through the center of the home.
introduction: Double-height living spaces, an open stair, and a dual-sided fireplace give the interior its sense of connection. Beyond the glass, a courtyard, pergola patio, and green side yard create a sequence of outdoor rooms.

sections.title: A room that reaches upward
body: Tall windows, vaulted volume, and the open stair make the living room the spatial center of the house. Built-in cabinetry and the dual-sided fireplace carry that connection into the adjacent family room.

sections.title: Kitchen, dining, and patio in one easy sequence
body: The center-island kitchen opens toward everyday dining and glass doors to the patio, keeping cooking, conversation, and outdoor access within one connected part of the plan.

sections.title: Outdoor rooms with shade and greenery
body: A sheltered courtyard, a pergola-framed rear patio, and a green side yard form distinct settings for a quiet morning, an open-air meal, or time in the garden.

neighborhood.title: Parks, practical stops, and regional rail
neighborhood.introduction: Stoneridge Place offers shared amenities and a convenient Pleasanton setting near neighborhood parks, everyday shopping, regional trails, and BART. Distances and availability should be independently verified.

highlights.title: Amaral Park
highlights.body: A mapped walking route is approximately half a mile. City materials identify playgrounds, picnic areas, ball backstops, and basketball courts.

highlights.title: Pacific Pearl
highlights.body: Approximately 0.8 driving mile by a mapped route, with a current mix of grocery, dining, and everyday services.

highlights.title: Dublin / Pleasanton BART
highlights.body: Approximately 3.1 driving miles by a mapped route, with local and regional transit connections.
